title: finding(console,ci): `main` is red on `Inert vi.mock Specifier Check` since PR objectui#10729 — `filterContextTokensSweep-10666.test.tsx` mocks a path inside `packages/plugin-map/node_modules`, which the pre-install check can never resolve
body:
Filing-gate category: ② a gate red on `main` with a named site (every open PR inherits the red row). Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that owns objectui#10666's code.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 2 session (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) while following PR objectui#10710 and PR objectui#10714, both of which show this red row without touching the file. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The reading

- `Inert vi.mock Specifier Check` (`node scripts/check-vi-mock-specifiers.mjs`, not a required check) fails on `main` from `f9c06ef6a` (PR objectui#10729, card objectui#10666, merged 2026-09-26T16:26Z) onward. `9c78ebe3a` before it is green; `f9c06ef6a` and `5c61e5241` are red.
- The one hit: `apps/console/src/__tests__/filterContextTokensSweep-10666.test.tsx:51`, `vi.mock('../../../../packages/plugin-map/node_modules/react-map-gl/dist/maplibre.js', …)`. The check reports it "resolves to no file on disk (tried 24 paths)".
- Why: the job runs `setup-node` and then the checker directly, with no `pnpm install`. A specifier that points into a `node_modules` directory can never resolve there. The test's own comment says the path was chosen because `apps/console` does not declare `react-map-gl`, so the bare specifier does not resolve from the app.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Two shapes, each keeping the mock real:
- declare `react-map-gl` where the test lives (an `apps/console` devDependency) and mock the bare `react-map-gl/maplibre`. Bare specifiers are out of this checker's scope (objectui#5646);
- or stub the map at a first-party seam `plugin-map` exposes, so the test mocks a workspace path that exists before install.

Either way, prove the mock is installed by the ablation the checker's own message asks for.

⛔ Not a fix: an allow-list entry, or teaching the checker to skip `node_modules` paths. Either would hide an inert mock, which is exactly what the gate exists to catch.

## Dedupe

objectui issues and PRs, the 200 most recently created, matched against `filterContextTokensSweep|vi\.mock Specifier|check-vi-mock-specifiers|react-map-gl/dist/maplibre`: no card. The hits are merged PRs that ran the checker, including the lit control PR objectui#10729 itself.
